description: This file defines the class 'RelativeStream' which implements the 'StreamInterface' from PSR-7 and provides a wrapper around another stream, representing a subset (starting from a given offset) of the initial stream. It includes methods to manipulate and access the underlying stream, adjusting behavior based on the offset.

classes.name: RelativeStream
classes.description: A wrapper stream class that represents a subpart of an initial stream starting at a given offset, avoiding copying data and conserving memory.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a RelativeStream with a decorated stream and an optional offset.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the stream contents as a string, seeking to the beginning if the stream is seekable.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream minus the offset.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream relative to the offset.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached EOF.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the underlying stream is seekable.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the stream, adjusting for the offset if whence is SEEK_SET.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream after verifying pointer position.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream after verifying pointer position.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Gets remaining contents of the stream after verifying pointer position.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata of the underlying stream.
